title: Director Krennic
subtitle: Galactic Empire
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Director Orson Krennic was the project engineer in charge of the secret Death Star operation, putting all of the pieces in place to get the Empire's ultimate wapon on line in time. Ultimately, the team he kidnapped to ensure the functioning of the Death Star's superlaser cost him his life and control of the project, as he was killed on Scarif in a test of the laser.
